meta.title: Loan simulator — OrentaLoan
meta.description: Estimate your monthly payment, total cost and indicative APR. Indicative figures, non-binding, subject to acceptance.

title: Loan simulator
subtitle: Adjust the parameters: everything recalculates in real time. Amounts are indicative.

amount.label: Loan amount
amount.help: The capital you wish to borrow.

duration.label: Repayment term
duration.help: A longer term lowers the monthly payment but raises the total cost.

rate.label: Fixed borrowing rate
rate.help: Indicative annual nominal rate for the estimate.

downPayment.label: Down payment (optional)
downPayment.help: A down payment reduces the financed amount.

actions.emailNote: We use your email only to send you this simulation.

disclaimer: Indicative, non-binding estimate, excluding insurance and any fees, subject to review and acceptance of your file. The final APR will appear on your contract offer.
